content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for District Court Cuttack Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://cuttack.dcourts.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 07-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the District Court Cuttack recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the District Court Cuttack recruitment is 07 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Clerk-cum-Copyist posts?
faq.answer: There are 22 vacancies available for the Junior Clerk-cum-Copyist post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for all posts is 18 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for Salaried Amin?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for Salaried Amin is Matriculation or equivalent and Revenue Inspector Training.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Junior Typist?
faq.answer: The salary for Junior Typist is based on Pay Matrix Rs. 19900-63200 at Level-4, which translates to Rs. 19900 - 69100 Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, Practical Test, Typewriting Test, and Viva-Voce.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, candidates must apply offline by sending the application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 42 years.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of District Court Cuttack, and links are provided in the Important Links section.
